reels.caption:
Sun and Sea are all you need. Check out the details below of this all-inclusive resort. 😍🏘🩵 @bossiselitetravel

📍Caribbean Sea

Overwater bungalows roughly 1.5 hours from Miami are found in Jamaica at resorts like Sandals Royal Caribbean and Sandals South Coast, which are easily accessible via a short flight from Miami. These all-inclusive options offer luxury, direct ocean access, and amenities like butler service, but also come with a substantial cost.

Sandals Resorts in Jamaica

• Sandals Royal Caribbean: Located in Montego Bay, this resort features overwater bungalows accessible by a short flight from Miami. It is an all-inclusive, adults-only option with features like a private deck, personal bar, and butler service.

• Sandals South Coast: Another all-inclusive resort in Jamaica that offers overwater bungalows accessible via a flight from Miami. It is noted for its "heart pathway" and includes amenities like a personal bar, butler service, and a glass-bottom floor for viewing marine life.

Key features of these resorts

• All-inclusive: Both resorts are all-inclusive, meaning your stay includes gourmet dining, top-shelf drinks, and various activities.

• Luxury amenities: Options like personal bars, butler service, private decks, and overwater hammocks are available.

• Direct ocean access: Many bungalows have direct access to the water for swimming, snorkeling, or enjoying the view.

• Proximity to Miami: The flight time from Miami is around 1.5 hours, making it a convenient option for a short getaway.
